item.title: Maldives Dive Boat Destroyed by Fire Near Feydhoo - Scuba Diving Magazine
item.description: A dive boat was destroyed by fire near Feydhoo harbour in the Maldives. Firefighters responded but the vessel later sank during rescue efforts

item.title: Elba Sidemount Festival 2026: Diving, CCR Demos and Workshops - Scuba Diving Magazine
item.description: The Elba Sidemount Festival returns to Elba Island, Italy from 24–26 April 2026 with dives, CCR demonstrations, DPV testing and workshops

item.title: High Seas Treaty in now Force: What it Means for Oceans & Divers - Scuba Diving Magazine
item.description: The High Seas Treaty (BBNJ) has officially entered into force. Here’s what the new global agreement means for marine protected areas, ocean conservation, and the future of pelagic ecosystems.

item.title: PADI Launches Hindi Open Water Diver eLearning for in India - Scuba Diving Magazine
item.description: PADI has released Hindi-language Open Water Diver eLearning, making scuba training more accessible for new divers across India.

item.title: Body of Diver Recovered After Training Dive Incident in Argentina - Scuba Diving Magazine
item.description: The body of a 23-year-old diver has been recovered near the Hu Shun Yu 809 wreck in Puerto Madryn, Argentina after she disappeared during a training dive

item.title: Sustainable Liveaboards: How Dive Boats Help Protect the Ocean - Scuba Diving Magazine
item.description: Modern, sustainable liveaboards are adopting new practices, from wastewater treatment and mooring buoys to plastic reduction & marine research support

item.title: Malta 2026 Tech Wreck Week Announced by FATHOM Expeditions - Scuba Diving Magazine
item.description: A new technical diving expedition in Malta will target wrecks from 40m to 115m, with eight dive days alongside Techwise Malta.

item.title: Diving Instructor Dies While Diving the Zenobia Wreck in Cyprus - Scuba Diving Magazine
item.description: A diving instructor has died during a training dive on the Zenobia in Cyprus. Authorities have launched an investigation into the fatal incident.

item.title: Sea&Sea Launches Universal MDX Housing for Nikon Z Cameras - Scuba Diving Magazine
item.description: Sea&Sea has launched a universal MDX underwater housing for Nikon Z mirrorless cameras, supporting camera bodies like the Z5, Z6 II and Z7 II

item.title: Chinese Billionaire Plans Mass-Market Yachts - What It Means for Divers and Liveaboards - Scuba Diving Magazine
item.description: A Chinese billionaire wants to make mass-market yachts affordable for ordinary buyers. The plan could reshape dive tourism, increase ocean pressure, and even disrupt the liveaboard diving industry.
